entities.name: RadioBearerConfig Information Element
entities.description: An information element that configures radio bearers including SRB, DRB, and MRB operations.

entities.name: SRB Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to release Signaling Radio Bearers (SRB3 or SRB4) when specified in RadioBearerConfig.

entities.name: SRB Addition or Reconfiguration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to add or reconfigure Signaling Radio Bearers when specified in RadioBearerConfig or when DAPS bearer is configured.

entities.name: DRB Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to release Data Radio Bearers when drb-ToReleaseList is included in RadioBearerConfig.

entities.name: DRB Addition or Reconfiguration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to add or reconfigure Data Radio Bearers when drb-ToAddModList is included in RadioBearerConfig.

entities.name: Multicast MRB Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to release multicast MRBs when mrb-ToReleaseList is included in RadioBearerConfig.

entities.name: Multicast MRB Addition or Reconfiguration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to add or reconfigure multicast MRBs when mrb-ToAddModList is included in RadioBearerConfig.

entities.name: SDAP Entity Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to release SDAP entities that have no associated DRB or multicast MRB and indicate release of user plane resources to upper layers.

entities.name: srb3-ToRelease present
entities.description: Condition when RadioBearerConfig includes the srb3-ToRelease field.

entities.name: srb4-ToRelease present
entities.description: Condition when RadioBearerConfig includes the srb4-ToRelease field.

entities.name: srb-ToAddModList present
entities.description: Condition when RadioBearerConfig includes the srb-ToAddModList field.

entities.name: drb-ToReleaseList present
entities.description: Condition when RadioBearerConfig includes the drb-ToReleaseList field.

entities.name: drb-ToAddModList present
entities.description: Condition when RadioBearerConfig includes the drb-ToAddModList field.

entities.name: mrb-ToReleaseList present
entities.description: Condition when RadioBearerConfig includes the mrb-ToReleaseList field.

entities.name: mrb-ToAddModList present
entities.description: Condition when RadioBearerConfig includes the mrb-ToAddModList field.

relations.description: Presence of srb3-ToRelease triggers SRB release procedure.
Presence of srb4-ToRelease triggers SRB release procedure.
Presence of srb-ToAddModList triggers SRB addition or reconfiguration procedure.
Presence of drb-ToReleaseList triggers DRB release procedure.
Presence of drb-ToAddModList triggers DRB addition or reconfiguration procedure.
Presence of mrb-ToReleaseList triggers multicast MRB release procedure.
Presence of mrb-ToAddModList triggers multicast MRB addition or reconfiguration procedure.
RadioBearerConfig IE triggers SDAP entity release procedure for entities without associated DRB or multicast MRB.
